steps.title: Who owes whom?
steps.intro: The bank is debtor and the depositor creditor. On a loan the borrower owes the bank. When collecting a bill the bank acts as agent for its customer, the principal. A trustee–beneficiary relationship arises in a trust arrangement. Special duties include honouring properly payable cheques and protecting confidentiality subject to lawful disclosures.
example: The bank owes the depositor.
